name: CodePal
summary: AI app builder that turns ideas into production software.
description: CodePal now presents itself as an AI app builder ('From idea to production. Your AI-powered dev team that ships real software, not demos'), with a CodePal Agent, in-app code edits and CodePal Cloud project hosting. Usage runs on credits. The free Starter plan ($0) includes 2 daily credits (up to 30 per month), up to 50 projects and limited Agent use; Standard is $25/month and Pro $50/month (annual billing) with 100 and 250 monthly credits, credit rollover and private projects; Enterprise is custom.

howToUse.title: Open CodePal
howToUse.description: Go to CodePal, the AI app builder, describe the product you want and start free with no credit card. The Starter plan includes 2 daily credits, up to 30 per month, up to 50 projects and limited Agent use.

howToUse.title: Let the Agent build and edit
howToUse.description: Use the CodePal Agent so it ships software for production rather than demos, then make in-app code edits while the build runs.

howToUse.title: Host the project
howToUse.description: Put the project on CodePal Cloud for hosting, publish a live URL and sync with GitHub. Usage runs on credits. Standard is $25 per month and Pro is $50 per month on annual billing, with 100 and 250 monthly credits, credit rollover and private projects. Enterprise is custom.
